# scm_dlp_config_export (Action)

Triggers an asynchronous export of the tenant Enterprise DLP configuration (/v1/api/configuration/export).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Export the tenant's DLP configuration.
#
# Usage:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.scm_dlp_config_export.backup

action "scm_dlp_config_export" "backup" {
  config {
    wait_for_completion = true
    timeout_ms          = 120000
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `export_type` (String) Optional export type (e.g. JSON or ALL).
- `poll_interval_ms` (Number) Polling interval in milliseconds when wait_for_completion is true (default: 1000).
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Maximum polling timeout in milliseconds when wait_for_completion is true (default: 30000).
- `wait_for_completion` (Boolean) When true, polls GET /v1/api/configuration/export/job/{jobId} until a terminal status (completed, cancelled, failed) and retrieves the download link.
